payload.description:
This market refers to the table tennis match between Kulishov Hryhorii and Kim Dmytro in Setka Cup Ukraine Men, originally scheduled for July 27, 2026 at 9:35PM ET.
This market will resolve to "Over" if Kulishov Hryhorii and Kim Dmytro combine to play 4 or more total games in the match. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Under".
For the purposes of this market, total games are calculated using all games played across the full match. Any forfeited points or games will count toward final settlement.
If the match is completed, this market will resolve based on the final completed match score. If a player retires, withdraws, is defaulted, is disqualified, or the match otherwise begins but is not completed, this market will resolve based on any outcome that was already unequivocally determined at the time play stopped.
For total games markets, an outcome is considered determined if it would have been guaranteed had the match been played to completion using the minimum number of additional games required. For example, if a total games market is Over/Under 3.5 and play stops with the score 2-1 in games, the players have played 3 total games, and the minimum completed score would require one additional game, resulting in at least 4 total games. Therefore, Over 3.5 would resolve as the winning outcome. If the market were Over/Under 4.5, the outcome would not be guaranteed and would resolve 50-50.
If neither outcome was already determined at the time play stopped, this market will resolve 50-50. If the match is canceled before play begins or delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without play beginning, this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Setka Cup results.

event_message.description:
This market refers to the table tennis match between Kulishov Hryhorii and Kim Dmytro in Setka Cup Ukraine Men, scheduled for July 27 at 9:35PM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Kulishov Hryhorii' if Kulishov Hryhorii wins against Kim Dmytro.

This market will resolve to 'Kim Dmytro' if Kim Dmytro wins against Kulishov Hryhorii.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

Therefore, Over 3.5 would resolve as the winning outcome. If the market were Over/Under 4.5, the outcome would not be guaranteed and would resolve 50-50.
If neither outcome was already determined at the time play stopped, this market will resolve 50-50. If the match is canceled before play begins or delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without play beginning, this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Setka Cup results.

This market will resolve to "Vorsulyak Yaroslav" if Vorsulyak Yaroslav wins by 2 or more games than Loboda Myroslav, based on the final completed match score. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Loboda Myroslav."
For the purposes of this market, game margin is calculated using total games won across the full match. Any forfeited points or games will count toward final settlement.
If the match is completed, this market will resolve based on the final completed match score. If a player retires, withdraws, is defaulted, is disqualified, or the match otherwise begins but is not completed, this market will resolve based on any outcome that was already unequivocally determined at the time play stopped.
For game spread markets, an outcome is considered determined if it would have been guaranteed had the match been played to completion using the minimum number of additional games required. For example, if play stops with one player leading 2-0 in games in a best-of-5 match, the minimum completion would be 3-0 in games; any game spread outcome already guaranteed under that minimum completion will resolve accordingly, while undetermined spreads will resolve 50-50.
If neither outcome was already determined at the time play stopped, this market will resolve 50-50. If the match is canceled before play begins or delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without play beginning, this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Setka Cup results.

payload.description:
This market refers to the table tennis match between Vorsulyak Yaroslav and Pohonov Oleksandr in Setka Cup Ukraine Men, originally scheduled for July 27, 2026 at 7:15PM ET.
This market will resolve to "Vorsulyak Yaroslav" if Vorsulyak Yaroslav wins by 2 or more games than Pohonov Oleksandr, based on the final completed match score. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Pohonov Oleksandr."
For the purposes of this market, game margin is calculated using total games won across the full match. Any forfeited points or games will count toward final settlement.
If the match is completed, this market will resolve based on the final completed match score. If a player retires, withdraws, is defaulted, is disqualified, or the match otherwise begins but is not completed, this market will resolve based on any outcome that was already unequivocally determined at the time play stopped.

payload.description:
This market refers to the table tennis match between Vorsulyak Yaroslav and Slozka Viktor in Setka Cup Ukraine Men, originally scheduled for July 27, 2026 at 8:45PM ET.
This market will resolve to "Vorsulyak Yaroslav" if Vorsulyak Yaroslav wins by 2 or more games than Slozka Viktor, based on the final completed match score. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Slozka Viktor."
For the purposes of this market, game margin is calculated using total games won across the full match. Any forfeited points or games will count toward final settlement.
If the match is completed, this market will resolve based on the final completed match score. If a player retires, withdraws, is defaulted, is disqualified, or the match otherwise begins but is not completed, this market will resolve based on any outcome that was already unequivocally determined at the time play stopped.
For game spread markets, an outcome is considered determined if it would have been guaranteed had the match been played to completion using the minimum number of additional games required. For example, if play stops with one player leading 2-0 in games in a best-of-5 match, the minimum completion would be 3-0 in games; any game spread outcome already guaranteed under that minimum completion will resolve accordingly, while undetermined spreads will resolve 50-50.
If neither outcome was already determined at the time play stopped, this market will resolve 50-50. If the match is canceled before play begins or delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without play beginning, this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Setka Cup results.

event_message.description:

This market will resolve to 'Slozka Viktor' if Slozka Viktor wins against Vorsulyak Yaroslav.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

payload.description:
This market refers to the table tennis match between Slozka Viktor and Hrekh Iurii in Setka Cup Ukraine Men, originally scheduled for July 27, 2026 at 7:45PM ET.
This market will resolve to "Over" if Slozka Viktor and Hrekh Iurii combine to play 4 or more total games in the match. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Under".
For the purposes of this market, total games are calculated using all games played across the full match. Any forfeited points or games will count toward final settlement.
If the match is completed, this market will resolve based on the final completed match score. If a player retires, withdraws, is defaulted, is disqualified, or the match otherwise begins but is not completed, this market will resolve based on any outcome that was already unequivocally determined at the time play stopped.
For total games markets, an outcome is considered determined if it would have been guaranteed had the match been played to completion using the minimum number of additional games required. For example, if a total games market is Over/Under 3.5 and play stops with the score 2-1 in games, the players have played 3 total games, and the minimum completed score would require one additional game, resulting in at least 4 total games. Therefore, Over 3.5 would resolve as the winning outcome. If the market were Over/Under 4.5, the outcome would not be guaranteed and would resolve 50-50.
If neither outcome was already determined at the time play stopped, this market will resolve 50-50. If the match is canceled before play begins or delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without play beginning, this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Setka Cup results.

event_message.description:
This market refers to the table tennis match between Slozka Viktor and Hrekh Iurii in Setka Cup Ukraine Men, scheduled for July 27 at 7:45PM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Slozka Viktor' if Slozka Viktor wins against Hrekh Iurii.

This market will resolve to 'Hrekh Iurii' if Hrekh Iurii wins against Slozka Viktor.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

payload.description:
This market refers to the table tennis match between Hrekh Iurii and Slozka Viktor in Setka Cup Ukraine Men, originally scheduled for July 27, 2026 at 7:45PM ET.
This market will resolve to "Hrekh Iurii" if Hrekh Iurii wins by 2 or more games than Slozka Viktor, based on the final completed match score. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Slozka Viktor."
For the purposes of this market, game margin is calculated using total games won across the full match. Any forfeited points or games will count toward final settlement.
If the match is completed, this market will resolve based on the final completed match score. If a player retires, withdraws, is defaulted, is disqualified, or the match otherwise begins but is not completed, this market will resolve based on any outcome that was already unequivocally determined at the time play stopped.
For game spread markets, an outcome is considered determined if it would have been guaranteed had the match been played to completion using the minimum number of additional games required. For example, if play stops with one player leading 2-0 in games in a best-of-5 match, the minimum completion would be 3-0 in games; any game spread outcome already guaranteed under that minimum completion will resolve accordingly, while undetermined spreads will resolve 50-50.
If neither outcome was already determined at the time play stopped, this market will resolve 50-50. If the match is canceled before play begins or delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without play beginning, this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Setka Cup results.

payload.description:
This market refers to the table tennis match between Sirbu Veaceslav and Barancean Sergiu in Setka Cup Moldova Men, originally scheduled for July 27, 2026 at 9:00PM ET.
This market will resolve to "Over" if Sirbu Veaceslav and Barancean Sergiu combine to play 5 or more total games in the match. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Under".
For the purposes of this market, total games are calculated using all games played across the full match. Any forfeited points or games will count toward final settlement.
If the match is completed, this market will resolve based on the final completed match score. If a player retires, withdraws, is defaulted, is disqualified, or the match otherwise begins but is not completed, this market will resolve based on any outcome that was already unequivocally determined at the time play stopped.
For total games markets, an outcome is considered determined if it would have been guaranteed had the match been played to completion using the minimum number of additional games required. For example, if a total games market is Over/Under 3.5 and play stops with the score 2-1 in games, the players have played 3 total games, and the minimum completed score would require one additional game, resulting in at least 4 total games. Therefore, Over 3.5 would resolve as the winning outcome. If the market were Over/Under 4.5, the outcome would not be guaranteed and would resolve 50-50.
If neither outcome was already determined at the time play stopped, this market will resolve 50-50. If the match is canceled before play begins or delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without play beginning, this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Setka Cup results.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

If a player retires, withdraws, is defaulted, is disqualified, or the match otherwise begins but is not completed, this market will resolve based on any outcome that was already unequivocally determined at the time play stopped.

If neither outcome was already determined at the time play stopped, this market will resolve 50-50. If the match is canceled before play begins or delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without play beginning, this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Setka Cup results.
